cmd: F=$(ls -d runs/*-D-local-suite-s0-h3base 2>/dev/null | tail -1)/memory_frozen.json; test -f "$F" || { echo "no frozen 7B arm-D playbook at $F"; exit 3; }; echo "arm F using playbook: $F"; .venv/bin/python -m harness.run_experiment --arm D --arm-label F --eval-only --load-memory "$F" --model qwen7b-ftE --seed 0 --out runs --tag h3
note: Arm F = hybrid: fine-tuned weights (qwen7b-ftE) + the frozen ACE playbook from the 7B arm-D seed-0 pilot, path resolved at runtime. Tag h3.
